scope: Repository seed baseline; no deployment database access, migrations, initialization, providers or network requests
reproducibility: Normalized UTF-8/LF source hashes; no wall-clock timestamp; fixed legacy map year explicitly recorded

runtime.reason: The app database accessor initializes/migrates data. It is deliberately not used by this read-only audit. Persisted counts remain null/unknown.

limitations: Source presence is not scholarly review or completion.
Image rights are retained intake metadata, not live URL/license re-verification.
Zero absent-dataset counts are limited to the reviewed seed registry; new source files require adapter reconciliation.
No production/private notes or credentials are read or published.

metrics.label: Catalog/work records
metrics.rule: Distinct work IDs; legacy texts and derived works are the same works, not additive.

metrics.label: Broad tradition groupings
metrics.rule: Distinct navigation grouping IDs; not reviewed community taxonomy.

metrics.label: Source editions
metrics.rule: Distinct edition IDs.

metrics.label: Searchable edition-backed works
metrics.rule: Distinct works with nonempty passages and edition source, license and hash metadata; not certification of primary content or license law.

metrics.label: Complete named-work/edition coverage
metrics.rule: Distinct populated works with edition complete flag; historical study vs named work remains source-specific.

metrics.label: Works without source editions
metrics.rule: No edition association, regardless of decorative metadata.

metrics.label: Edition segments
metrics.rule: Distinct segment IDs; not all segments are primary text.

metrics.label: Explicitly classified primary segments
metrics.rule: Only explicit contentType labels count; edition wording does not establish primary status.

metrics.label: Explicitly classified editorial segments
metrics.rule: Only explicit contentType labels count; edition wording does not establish primary status.

metrics.label: Unclassified/unknown segments
metrics.rule: Segments not explicitly labeled primary or editorial.

metrics.label: Museum artifacts

metrics.label: Archive image references

metrics.label: Images with source/rights/attribution

metrics.label: Institutions represented by image records

metrics.label: Institutional image object types

metrics.label: Images with retained source hashes
metrics.rule: Records with a SHA-256 hash of the retained institutional API response; legacy records are not backfilled with invented hashes.

metrics.label: Images with institutional IIIF Image services
metrics.rule: Image records carrying the institution's IIIF Image service; an Atlas-generated presentation manifest does not count.

metrics.label: Images retaining institutional IIIF manifests
metrics.rule: Image records retaining an institution-maintained Presentation manifest independently of the Atlas display manifest.

metrics.label: Curated relationship records

metrics.label: Works without start dates

metrics.label: Works with coordinates

metrics.label: Works without coordinates

metrics.label: Map-eligible works through 2026

metrics.label: Timeline-eligible works through 2026

metrics.label: Curated comparison packs
metrics.rule: Distinct pack IDs. A named pack is not evidence that every requested source range is evidence-ready.

metrics.label: Comparison-pack source slots
metrics.rule: Distinct requested source-range slots across all seven packs, regardless of evidence state.

metrics.label: Evidence-ready comparison-pack slots
metrics.rule: Slots explicitly marked evidence-ready with a resolved passage or bounded research reference; metadata alone never counts.

metrics.label: Metadata-only comparison-pack slots
metrics.rule: Slots explicitly marked metadata-only. These remain visible gaps and do not count as comparative evidence.

metrics.label: Unclassified comparison-pack source selections
metrics.rule: Bounded selections whose passage source role is still Unknown. They remain inspectable but cannot support comparison findings.

metrics.label: Comparison-pack slots missing a source
metrics.rule: Slots explicitly marked missing-source with a visible gap; a title or requested range does not satisfy the evidence requirement.

metrics.label: Culturally restricted comparison-pack slots
metrics.rule: Community-specific slots explicitly marked culturally restricted and linked to protocol records; their metadata remains discoverable but source content is excluded.

metrics.label: Source-aware comparison-pack outputs
metrics.rule: Distinct authored outputs split into evidence-backed findings and non-evidentiary coverage/protocol notes, each with source categories, influence assessments and cautions.

metrics.label: Research-engine source records
metrics.rule: Distinct cited source records retained with perspective and verification metadata; source presence is not independent scholarly review of every claim.

metrics.label: Reviewed opposition propositions
metrics.rule: Distinct reviewed propositions used to retrieve attributed stances; tradition names alone never create opposition.

metrics.label: Attributed opposition stances
metrics.rule: Distinct proposition-linked stances with speaker/community, context, uncertainty, confidence and citations.

metrics.label: Research comparison-engine cases
metrics.rule: Distinct comparison cases. Mode-specific evidence items are counted separately and similarity never creates an influence relationship.

metrics.label: Mode-specific comparison evidence items
metrics.rule: Distinct subject claims, synthesis findings, similarities, contradictions, chronology findings, documented influence relationships and alternative interpretations across reviewed cases.

metrics.label: Teaching-versus-conduct cases
metrics.rule: Distinct historical cases that keep teaching, conduct, actors, motives, contemporary voices and later interpretations separate.

metrics.label: Teaching-versus-conduct evidence items
metrics.rule: Distinct supported and cited items across all nine required evidence lanes; documented gaps are measured separately and cannot inflate this count.

metrics.label: Teaching-versus-conduct documented evidence gaps
metrics.rule: Distinct cited absence records explicitly tagged documented-gap. A gap keeps a required review lane visible but never counts as evidence.
